description: HR-34 is the official Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) code for the Mahendragarh subdivision in Haryana. It primarily handles the registration of non-transport vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses for the local sub-district area, while the district headquarters in Narnaul operates under code HR-35.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Mahendragarh, Haryana
